paper.title_en: Gravitational Waves from Post-Inflationary Magnetism: Direct and Scalar-Induced Contributions
paper.abstract_en: We study stochastic gravitational waves generated in a post-inflationary magnetogenesis scenario with time-dependent gauge couplings during inflation and reheating. In this setup, magnetic anisotropic stress directly sources gravitational waves, while the induced curvature perturbations generate an additional scalar-induced GW component. We compare the spectral behavior of the two contributions and find that the magnetic component dominates the peak amplitude, whereas the scalar-induced contribution becomes important on larger scales. For blue magnetic spectra with $n_{\rm b}\geq3/2$, both spectra follow the universal infrared scaling $Ω_{\rm GW}(f\ll f_{\rm peak})\propto f^3$. However, their ultraviolet behaviors differ significantly for $f>f_{\rm peak}$, leading to distinct spectral features. For suitable reheating and magnetogenesis parameters, the resulting GW signal naturally extends into the nano-Hz range relevant for pulsar timing array observations, while remaining consistent with current bounds. The distinct spectral features of the two components may provide a useful probe of reheating dynamics and primordial magnetogenesis.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文直接探讨了原初磁发生产生的引力波信号，并与脉冲星计时阵列观测相关，属于PTA领域的相关研究。
decision.title_zh: 膨胀后磁引力波：直接和标量诱导贡献
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在膨胀和再加热期间具有时间依赖规范耦合的膨胀后磁发生场景中产生的随机引力波。在这种设置中，磁各向异性应力直接产生引力波，而诱导的曲率扰动产生额外的标量诱导引力波分量。我们比较了这两种贡献的光谱行为，发现磁分量主导峰值幅度，而标量诱导贡献在更大尺度上变得重要。对于具有$n_{\rm b}\geq3/2$的蓝色磁谱，两种谱都遵循普适的红外标度$Ω_{\rm GW}(f\ll f_{\rm peak})\propto f^3$。然而，它们的紫外行为在$f>f_{\rm peak}$时显著不同，导致不同的光谱特征。对于合适的再加热和磁发生参数，产生的引力波信号自然延伸到与脉冲星计时阵列观测相关的纳赫兹范围，同时与当前限制保持一致。两个分量的不同光谱特征可能为再加热动力学和原初磁发生提供有用的探针。
